title: gossypium hirsutum f. tomentosum
intro: Gossypium hirsutum f. tomentosum, commonly known as the Mexican cotton, is a subspecies of the cotton plant native to Mexico and Central America. It is a herbaceous plant with medicinal properties, valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various skin conditions, wounds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Mexican cotton include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. These bioactive compounds may help in soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing, making Mexican cotton a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
